authority: Historical 96-spell launch selection with 47 additions to existing class/subclass progression. Sixteen deferred profiles remain preserved. No new class or subclass is selected by this record; the current catalogue adds exactly 21 preserved implementations for the 117-spell Lite launch.
final_roster_authority: 117 launch spells: the original 96 Lite profiles and exactly 21 preserved implementations.

progression_justifications.justification: Bard cantrip deficit at4 and Warlock deficits at4/10; retained working Lite source.
Cleric five-cantrip base capacity at10; also Druid Magician extra choice capacity.
Second additional Cleric cantrip for five base choices at10.
Sixth distinct Cleric cantrip preserves the existing optional Thaumaturge extra-cantrip order at10 alongside five ordinary choices.
Interchangeable rank6 Warlock Arcanum choice at11; reuse the retained generic area-damage family exercised by other current native spells.
Interchangeable rank7 Warlock Arcanum choice at13; retained SRD source and explicit source-adoption/planar-consumer tests already exist.
Second shared Bard/Warlock cantrip; four distinct Warlock cantrips are required at10.
